predecessor.reason: V2 leaves GradScaler at the trainer default of 65536. V3 is a separate numeric successor after an observed startup overflow risk; it is not an exact V2 reproduction.

changed_factor.name: FP16 GradScaler initial scale
changed_factor.scope: Both arms, both actual-device profile and conditional fit
changed_factor.interpretation: This is an explicitly identified numerical successor. The lower initial scale is not a response selected on evaluation labels. Zero AMP skips remain a strict profile and fit validity gate.

data.fitting_subset: exactly the first 512 components from the seed-540 permutation of sorted eligible component IDs; all fitting sequences in each selected component are included
data.membership_protocol_correction_from_v2: The preserved V2 10%-of-components rule yields 315 of 3,148 eligible components under the frozen split, rather than its stated 512. V3 therefore freezes exactly 512 by seed-540 permutation rank; it is not described as a 10% subset or the same-size V2 realization.
data.dropped_sequence_identity: unknown in the packet; the exact row is not inferred from the seed without an observed loader trace

knot_fit.row_selection: evenly spaced positions including sequence endpoints
knot_fit.quantiles: n_intervals+1 equally spaced empirical quantiles; duplicate values dropped per feature

loss.validity_mask: repository warmup validity; same for both arms

resource_envelope.reason: The 800-second provider/worker margin covers kernel startup, bundle mount/extraction and terminal artifact transport. Exact mounted-input SHA-256 runs inside the 5,200-second worker cap and is included in its projection; root checks live quota and observed input-hash throughput before submission.

promotion: A one-seed small-data screen can allocate a larger fidelity test; it cannot establish training-seed robustness, public transfer or final submission value.
